description_en: Updates an SAP HANA backup plan
name: UpdateHanaBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the backup plan
parameters.name: plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The backup policy. Valid format: `I|{startTime}|{interval}`. This format specifies that a backup job is executed at an interval of {interval} starting from {startTime}. Missed backup jobs are not compensated. If the previous backup job is not completed, the next backup job is not triggered. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` specifies that a backup is performed every day starting from 14:00:00 on September 15, 2021.

startTime: the start time of the backup. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
interval: the ISO 8601 time interval. For example, PT1H specifies an interval of one hour, and P1D specifies an interval of one day
parameters.help_zh:
备份策略。可选格式：`I|{startTime}|{interval}`。表示从{startTime}开始每隔{interval}的时间执行一次备份任务。不会补偿已过去时间的备份任务。如果上一次备份任务没有完成，不会触发下一次备份任务。例如`I|1631685600|P1D`表示从2021-09-15 14:00:00开始每隔一天备份一次。

startTime：备份起始时间，UNIX时间，单位秒。
interval： ISO8601时间间隔。例如：PT1H表示间隔一小时。P1D表示间隔一天
parameters.name: schedule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
